end.summary:
Practised keeping track of objects by making one mark for each object.
Matched marks back to objects to identify missing or extra items; 4 of 4 attempts were correct without help.
Parth first linked two marks to one large cow, then corrected this to one mark per cow.
Parth initially thought spread-out rows had more objects, but later corrected this by matching each object one-to-one; the explanation without number names was not yet complete.
end.parentNote: Asha practised one-to-one matching with marks, stones, animals, and objects. Parth used the matching method correctly to check whether anything was missing or extra, and corrected the idea that spread-out objects are more after matching them one by one. At home, place a few household objects in two differently spaced rows and ask Parth to pair each object with one mark or object without counting aloud.
